data.title: 黄泉 · 梳理长发
data.description: 旅途结束后，黄泉坐在镜前梳理长发。梳子停在发梢，她从镜中望向桌上的旅途照片。
data.promptProse: Sitting before an antique mahogany dressing table illuminated by the warm, nostalgic glow of a fringe-shaded lamp, Acheron slowly draws an engraved tortoiseshell comb through the long ends of her flowing violet-tipped white hair. Scattered across the vanity are faded black-and-white travel photographs, dried spider lilies, and her sheathed nodachi resting quietly against the wall.
data.animaCaption: Her comb pauses at the ends of her hair.
